name: labs/aaron-mott__keithley-2230g
title: Keithley 2230G multi-channel power supply
intro: Keithley 2230G multi-channel power supply, adapted from aaron-mott/keithley-2230g. It reads `measured_voltage_ch1`, `measured_voltage_ch2`, `measured_voltage_ch3`, `measured_current_ch1` and 2 more; sets `voltage_setpoint_ch1`, `voltage_setpoint_ch2`, `voltage_setpoint_ch3`, `current_limit_ch1` and 5 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: disable all three channel outputs (safe state). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
